title: Legend Node Schema
description: JSON Schema for Legend Node definitions. Legend Nodes are irreversible behavioral trials that gate tail unlocks in Legends of Kai-Jax.

node_id.description: Unique identifier for the Legend Node

tail_unlocked.description: Exact tail number unlocked by completing this node (4-9 only, as tails 1-3 are starting)

name.description: Display name for the Legend Node trial

location.description: Zone name where this Legend Node is located

unlock_conditions.description: Conditions required to attempt this Legend Node

starting_tail_count_required.description: Player must have exactly this many tails to attempt (enforces sequential progression)

trial_rules.description: Rules that govern the trial behavior

healing_disabled.description: Whether healing abilities are disabled during trial

revives_disabled.description: Whether revive abilities are disabled during trial

environmental_kills_allowed.description: Whether environmental kills count toward victory

difficulty_scaling.description: How trial difficulty scales with player progression

victory_conditions.description: Conditions that must be met to succeed in the trial

posture_breaks_required.description: Number of enemy posture breaks required

enemies_defeated_required.description: Number of enemies that must be defeated

excessive_damage_taken.description: Whether exceeding damage threshold causes failure

time_limit_exceeded.description: Whether exceeding time limit causes failure

tail.description: Name of the tail being unlocked

visual_change.description: Diegetic description of the visual transformation

combat_unlocks.description: Combat abilities or mechanics unlocked with this tail
